'''Remata''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] employee of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Lestra Oxic]]. He worked for the attorney, providing security and covert services as one of his [[Agent/Legends|agents]]. In [[43 ABY]], he was assigned to the pursuit of [[Tobb Jadak]] along with [[Cynner]].
